Example AI Club

The Example AI Club brings students, researchers and founders together in Munich to build with machine learning. Members run reading groups, hack nights and a yearly conference, and the club works with the universities and startups of the city.

Our programmes run over one semester: a builders track for teams shipping a product, a research track for students who want to publish, and a mentoring track that pairs members with engineers from industry partners.

Join us

Every talk and workshop is announced on our Luma calendar. Applications for the next cohort open every spring.
